plan.title: EXP-DRAFT-040 — 1-hour preset hidden on saved eRFX draft

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation required for the draft.
Apply the setting under test so vendors cannot be added during event creation.
Apply the case's required stage configuration.
Give the draft a searchable title; create tests require a title.
Apply the first available template so line items and scheduling can be configured.
Add the minimum line item needed for a valid draft.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Commit an initial schedule so the saved draft has a schedule control to reopen.
Save the configured eRFX event as a draft.
Confirm the draft save completed without an application error.
Navigate to the Events list to locate the saved draft.
Confirm the events list rendered before filtering.
Open the Drafts tab required by the case.
Verify the draft created by this test is present in Drafts.
Open the saved draft from the Drafts list.
Open the draft's schedule drawer to inspect the available duration presets.
Assert that the 1-hour duration preset is not offered on the saved draft.
